ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:

since $AD$ is the angle bisector of $\triangle ABC$, $DE\perp AB$, and $DF\perp AC$, \\
thus $DE=DF=2$, \\
therefore the area of $\triangle ADB=\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot DE=\frac{1}{2}\times 5\times 2=5$, \\
since the area of $\triangle ABC$ is 8, \\
thus the area of $\triangle ADC$ is $8-5=3$, \\
thus $\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot DF=3$, \\
thus $\frac{1}{2}AC\times 2=3$, \\
thus $AC=\boxed{3}$,
